description: The best Christmas gifts for kids under £20 in 2026, from toddlers to age 12, with half-price Bluey, PAW Patrol, LEGO and Hot Wheels deals.

body:
## How to pick a good gift under £20

£20 is a sweet spot for kids' presents. It's enough for a proper branded toy rather than a stocking filler, and this month many £30–£40 toys have been cut to under £20. A few tips before you buy:

- **Go for a character they already love.** Bluey, PAW Patrol, Minecraft and Pokémon toys get played with because the child already knows the world. If you're unsure, ask the parents what they're into this year.
- **Check the age label.** Toys with small parts are marked 3+, and some LEGO sets are designed for older kids. Toddler toys like the Bluey laptop are made to survive being chewed and thrown.
- **Watch the batteries.** Light-up and sound toys often need AA or AAA batteries that aren't included.
- **Use the multi-buys.** Argos has 2 for £15, 2 for £20 and 3 for £20 offers on hundreds of toys. They're great for buying for siblings or for a few cousins at once. The Bluey laptop, Minecraft Creeper and LEGO Darth Maul Mech above are all in Argos's 2 for £20 range.

## Best gifts by age

**Toddlers (1–3):** the **Bluey My First Laptop** (£7.50) is the cheapest pick here and a simple first toy for little ones. The **Bluey Police Car** (£13.49 at Smyths) comes with a figure and suits ages 3 and up.

**Ages 3–5:** the **PAW Patrol Chomp and Rescue Rubble bulldozer** is half price at £15, and the **Hot Wheels 8-car pack** at £8 is the safest bet for car-mad kids. The **Barbie horse and doll set** with Barbie and Stacie is half price at £20.

**Ages 5–8:** the **Hot Wheels T-Rex Blaze Battle track set** is £18, down from £35, and a Squishmallow suits almost any child in this age group. The **Prince the Pug** 12-inch plush is £12.50.

**Ages 8–12:** the **LEGO Star Wars Darth Maul Mech** (£13) is a quick, satisfying build, and the **Minecraft Creeper plush** (£7.50) is a cheap win with gamers. For Harry Potter fans, the **Squishmallows Hogwarts Express** set is down to £9 as John Lewis clears stock.

## What's a good price?

Use these as rough targets this Christmas:

- **Branded character toys (Bluey, PAW Patrol, Barbie):** half the list price is a great deal. Argos already has many at 50% off.
- **Small LEGO sets:** around 20–30% off the RRP. Bigger sets get the deepest cuts on Black Friday (27 November), so see our [LEGO Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for those.
- **Squishmallows:** under £13 for a 12-inch plush is a good price.
- **Hot Wheels car packs:** around £1 per car.

## When do kids' toy prices drop?

Most of the cheaper toys in this guide are already at their Black Friday prices, as Argos and Smyths started their toy sales in early November. Prices on small toys rarely fall much further before Christmas, but popular characters do sell out. If you see the right toy at around half price, buy it. Argos's **Price Guarantee** badge also means that if a badged toy gets cheaper before Christmas Day, you'll get the difference back as an e-gift card.

For the year's big-name toys, see our [Christmas toy deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/). For cheaper presents, try our [Secret Santa gifts under £10](/guides/secret-santa-gifts-under-10/), and for something educational, our [STEM gifts for kids](/guides/stem-gifts-for-kids/). Every guide is on our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) page.

## FAQs

### What's a good Christmas present for a child under £20?

A toy from a character they already love, at a discount. This year's best value is the PAW Patrol Rubble bulldozer at £15 (was £30) for younger kids, or a LEGO Star Wars Mech at £13 for ages 6 and up.

### Are Argos toys cheaper than Smyths?

Often they're the same, sometimes to the penny. Argos has more half-price offers and multi-buys right now, while Smyths sometimes has small toys a little cheaper. Check both before you buy.

### Should I wait for Black Friday to buy kids' toys?

For small toys under £20, usually not. Many are already half price, and popular lines can sell out in late November. The exception is LEGO, which tends to see its biggest cuts on 27 November.

### What age is Squishmallows for?

Squishmallows are soft toys that suit almost any age, including teenagers. Some play sets, like the Hogwarts Express, are labelled 6+ because of small parts.
